name: Macro Oscillator 2
description: This algorithm is an implementation of the open source Plaits module by Émilie Gillet. This implementation should behave and sound identical to the original. Any demos or tutorials you may find online should apply just as well to this version. The user manual for the original module is available online. The documentation below assumes some familiarity with this. This version of the disting NT firmware is based on v1.2 of the Plaits code. The original Plaits module made extensive use of detecting which inputs had jacks plugged in and adjusting its behaviour accordingly. The disting NT has no way of knowing whether its sockets are connected or not, so this algorithm relies on the various 'input' settings being enabled or not. As on the original Plaits, there are two outputs, 'Main' and 'Aux'. If you select the same bus for both outputs they are mixed.
